correctness.rationale: For each m=0,...,4, the spherical cap concentration eigenvalue equals the normalized integral from t to 1 of (1-u^2)^m times the square of the m-th derivative of P4. A standalone standard-library exact-rational checker reconstructs all five polynomials and all ten factored pairwise differences coefficient-by-coefficient. The main cubic is strictly monotone (derivative discriminant -37280); the remaining factor signs give the five unique maximizing modes and transition multiplicities. The four explicit m-4 factorized gaps are positive for 0<t<1, including the nontrivial m=0 gap certified by 51-1605/3220>0. Independent numerical quadratures are only consistency tests, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is the complete sharp concentration and inverse-restriction geometry of a natural nine-dimensional exact spherical harmonic eigenspace on two antipodal observation caps. Beyond known general spectral matrix formulas and the earlier degree-three case, it reveals an intermediate m=2 maximizing phase, reentrant m=0 optimality, an exact five-dimensional resonance, and a uniform bottom order-four sector. The exact algebraic cutoff values allow rigorous cap-radius design and conditioning comparisons without numerical diagonalization.
